source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of legal ramifications (PDF 177-178).

blocks.text: Terms of Use todne (violate karne) ke sangeen legal consequences (qanooni nataij) ho sakte hain. User par jurmana (fine) lag sakta hai, us par muqadma (sue) ho sakta hai, ya us par service istemal karne ki pabandi (ban) lag sakti hai.

Misalein: Proper license ke baghair software istemal karna software piracy (software ki chori) hai, jis par qanooni karwai ho sakti hai. Jo companies unlicensed (baghair license) software istemal karti hain unhein qanooni khatre bhi hote hain aur cybersecurity threats (computer ki hifazat ke khatre) bhi. Doosri misal PayPak jaisi digital payment service ki Terms of Use todna hai: fraud (dhoka dahi) ya unauthorized (baghair ijazat) transactions karne par qanooni saza ho sakti hai, jaise jurmana ya criminal charges (fojdari muqadma).

blocks.prompt: Baghair license software istemal karne ke do khatre bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Pehla: software piracy par qanooni karwai (jurmana ya muqadma). Doosra: cybersecurity ka khatra, kyunke chori ki copies mein malware ho sakta hai aur unhein security updates nahi milte.

items: Terms of Use todne par jurmana, muqadma ya service se pabandi ho sakti hai.
Misalein: software piracy; PayPak par fraud ya baghair ijazat transactions (jurmana ya fojdari muqadma).
